scientific_queries.note: Leave-one-cell-line-out test on the locally held GDSC screen; no novelty claim.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the effect is small and consistently positive, and the round states both the positive condition and its size limit.

design.prediction: mean synergy of other cells (all, or same tissue only), scored per held-out cell by Spearman

significance: this is the first scope condition in the programme that both works (92% of cells agree) and is statistically supported (CI excludes zero); earlier attempts (R12 confidence model, R16 conformal width, R17 rule boundary, R27 source agreement) all failed or were untestable
size_limit: the gain is only +0.025 in rank correlation; three coarse tissues; it concerns ranking, not magnitude

register_updates.C25: new, exploratory: unseen-cell rho 0.502; same-tissue +0.0247 with 92% of cells agreeing

next_gates: cross-screen replication using the validation screen (4,725 overlapping keys at different concentrations) - attribution of any non-replication to concentration vs irreproducibility must be designed first
